defaultExpandedIds.description: Ids of the folders expanded on first render, when expansion is left uncontrolled.

defaultSelectedId.description: Id of the row selected on first render, when selection is left uncontrolled.

expandedIds.description: Ids of the expanded folders. Supply this to control expansion.

onExpandedChange.description: Called with the next expanded-id set whenever a folder opens or closes.

onSelect.description: Called with the node whose row was activated, by click or by `Enter`/`Space`.

selectedId.description: Id of the selected row. Supply this to control selection; the component then holds no shadow state.
